title: Dutch Jubilant Fritters
description: A delicious and crispy snack made with jubilant and dutch flavors, served with a side of potato salad.
instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, baking powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together sugar, eggs, and milk.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Add the melted butter and stir until the batter is smooth.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the batter into the hot oil.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate.
Serve the fritters hot with a side of potato salad.
To make the potato salad, boil diced potatoes until tender.
In a separate bowl, whisk together mayonnaise and chopped fresh herbs.
Add the boiled potatoes to the bowl and toss with the mayonnaise mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
